offering_description.value: Provides professional employer organization (PEO) services, including payroll, HR, workers' compensation and benefits administration, to small and mid-sized businesses. Also offers staffing and temporary employment services. Delivered through branch offices with local sales and service teams.

primary_services.value: PEO services; payroll processing; workers' compensation insurance; employee benefits administration; staffing and temporary labor

customer_segment.value: B2B: small and mid-sized businesses across industries needing outsourced HR, payroll and staffing

end_markets.value: light industrial; construction; professional services; hospitality; healthcare; technology

revenue_model.value: service fees: PEO fees based on client payroll and worksite employee costs; service fees: staffing and temporary labor billings to clients

value_chain_position.value: service provider: co-employs client workers and handles HR, payroll, benefits and risk for small and mid-sized businesses

geography_served.value: US regional: Mainly California, Oregon, Washington, Maryland, Utah, Arizona, Colorado, Idaho and other states through branch offices

specialization.value: related lines: PEO services and staffing, both workforce outsourcing for employers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: branch-based sales teams selling to local businesses; agents / brokers: insurance brokers and referral partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: employment, payroll tax, benefits and workers' compensation rules, state PEO licensing, ACA and ERISA, IRS certification
